name: vivari
description: An open-source WebContainer: run Node-style projects fully client-side in the browser.

scripts.predev: npm run vendor:npm && npm run vendor:yarn && npm run vendor:pnpm && npm run vendor:corepack && npm run vendor:tsgo && npm run vendor:pyodide && npm run vendor:sqlite
scripts.prebuild:studio: npm run vendor:npm && npm run vendor:yarn && npm run vendor:pnpm && npm run vendor:corepack && npm run vendor:tsgo && npm run vendor:pyodide && npm run vendor:sqlite
scripts.build:wasi-demo: mkdir -p packages/wasi-demo/pkg && cargo build --release --manifest-path packages/wasi-demo/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-wasip1 && cp packages/wasi-demo/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/wasi_demo.wasm packages/wasi-demo/pkg/wasi_demo.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:vfs && npm run build:vfs:node && npm run build:codec && npm run build:codec:node && npm run build:crypto && npm run build:crypto:node && npm run build:wasi-demo
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build:core && npm run build:react
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck --workspace @vivari/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @vivari/react
